# Municipal Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2025

**The Adoption of Quezon Universal Health Care Ordinance of 2024**

## Summary

This ordinance adopts Provincial Ordinance No. 2024-024, which institutionalizes the establishment and operationalization of the Quezon Province-wide Health System (PWHS), including its management support systems, in accordance with the Universal Health Care (UHC) Act of 2019. It integrates the Municipality of Pitogo into the province-wide health system and appropriates funds for its implementation.

## Key Provisions

1. **Declaration of Policy** (Section 2): Adopts Provincial Ordinance No. 2024-024 entitled "An Ordinance Institutionalizing the Establishment and Operationalization of the Quezon Province-Wide Health System, Including Its Management Support Systems, in Accordance with the Universal Health Care Act, and Appropriating Funds Thereof." Commits to improving health outcomes and quality of life for constituents.

2. **Objective** (Section 3): Sustain and institutionalize health reforms initiated with the Province of Quezon under the UHC Act of 2019, establishing an integrated local health system.

3. **Implementation Arrangement** (Section 4):
   - The [[Municipal Government of Pitogo]], through the [[Municipal Health Board]], shall implement the ordinance
   - The [[Municipal Health Board]] shall support the [[Province Health Care Provider Network]] (PCPN) and the [[Primary Care Provider Network]] establishment
   - Management support systems include:
     - i. Local Investment Plan for Health and Annual Operational Plan
     - ii. Human Resources for Health Management and Development (HRHMD) System
     - iii. Information Management System
     - iv. Epidemiology and Surveillance System (ESS)
     - v. Supply Chain Management System (SCMS)
     - vi. Patient Navigation and Referral System (PNRS)
     - vii. Disaster Risk Reduction and Management in Health (DRRM-H) System
     - viii. Health Promotion Programs and Campaigns (HPPC)
   - The [[Municipal Health Office]] shall be the technical secretariat

4. **Appropriations** (Section 5): Funds to be included in the 2026 Annual Budget and increased in subsequent years subject to availability.

5. **Repealing Clause** (Section 7): All prior ordinances, resolutions, executive orders, and administrative rules inconsistent with this ordinance are repealed or modified.

6. **Effectivity** (Section 8): Takes effect in accordance with Republic Act No. 7160 (Local Government Code of 1991).
